'''Emperor Marcus the Great''' was a Vesperan emperor whose reign is given in source material as 1750-1780. He is associated with the later standardization of the [[Imperial Coronation Ceremony]] and the mature ceremonial form of the [[Imperial Cult]].

== Canon Note ==

One source also associates Marcus with the establishment of the [[Imperial Religious Academy]] in 1720, which conflicts with the reign dates above. Until confirmed, this draft treats Marcus as a later patron or standardizer of imperial religious institutions rather than the Academy's original founder.
